A '''golden chestplate''' is a [[Armor#Chestplate|chestplate]] of the [[Golden equipment|golden]] tier, crafted from eight [[gold ingot]]s. At 5 armor it sits between the [[Copper Chestplate|copper]] (4) and [[iron chestplate]] (6), and equals the [[sturdy leather gambeson]].

=== Loot ===

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
It gives 5 armor and has 200 durability (vanilla: 112). The full golden set gives 12 armor, less than iron but more than copper, and piglins accept it as usual.

=== Enchantments ===
Each piece has [[Fire Protection]]: II on the crown, leggings and boots and III on the chestplate. Golden gear comes with its enchantments already applied. They are ordinary enchantments, so they can be combined or removed like any other.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[gold ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

It melts down into one gold ingot in a [[blast furnace]].
